about.title: About Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy
about.lead: The Plague Tale prequel, set 15 years before Requiem. Young plunderer Sophia braves Minotaur Island and uncovers the origins of the Macula through echoes of the Minoan age. Combat, puzzles and full collectibles — all in one place.

footer.about: Resonance Plague Tale Wiki is an independent fan site covering beginner guides, skill builds, complete charm and blade locations, the chapter list, the ending explained, and language support for Resonance: A Plague Tale Legacy. Our goal: every secret of Minotaur Island, explained.
